description: It appears that during a critical time in Oregon, while wildfires raged and voters wondered where their Congresswoman was, Val Hoyle relaxed at a waterfront hotel in Maine. Today, Oregon Fourth Congressional District Candidate Monique DeSpain reacted to news of an FEC complaint filed by a local resident alleging an apparent unlawful use of “campaign funds for personal use for vacation and travel, violating the FEC’s standard of the irrespective test.
